searchText: have there been any thought into using the portal network to keep blob history past the data availability window? Yes, there were discussions on the topic. It's something that can easily be added on top of the portal network. But working on it is not a priority at this moment, as there is no clear use case and consumer of this data.

excerpts.content: have there been any thought into using the portal network to keep blob history past the data availability window?

excerpts.author: milos88
excerpts.content:
Yes, there were discussions on the topic. It's something that can easily be added on top of the portal network.
But working on it is not a priority at this moment, as there is no clear use case and consumer of this data.
